name: Investigate the Scourge of Darnassus
summary: Lieutenant Beitha calls for help as the Scourge encampments press close to Darnassus. The Argent Dawn needs defenders to strike the undead and learn what the runes outside the gates are for.

sections.title: A Plague on the World Tree
sections.body: The Scourge has reached Teldrassil, and floating necropolises loom above the invasion camps near Darnassus. Ghouls, skeletons, and other undead horrors spill from them. Lieutenant Beitha of the Argent Dawn coordinates the city's defense, calling on volunteers to slow the attack and gather information before the undead overwhelm the night elven homeland.

sections.title: Whispers in the Runes
sections.body: The undead are not the only concern near the Scourge camps. Lieutenant Beitha asks defenders to collect dim necrotic stones from slain Scourge and inspect the glowing runic circles on the ground. Their whispers reach anyone who steps close. The circles carry messages, but Beitha does not know whom the Scourge are contacting.

aliases: who gives investigate the scourge of darnassus
faq.answer: Lieutenant Beitha is an Argent Dawn officer stationed at Darnassus. She organizes resistance to the Scourge and asks defenders to thin their numbers and study their necromantic devices.

faq.q: Why is the Scourge attacking Darnassus?
faq.answer: Scourge forces are camped outside Darnassus beneath a necropolis. Lieutenant Beitha asks defenders to reduce their numbers and investigate nearby runic circles.

faq.q: What are the glowing runic circles outside the city?
faq.answer: The glowing runic circles lie near the Scourge forces. Lieutenant Beitha asks you to investigate their purpose.
Dim Necrotic Stones come from Scourge invaders. Defenders bring them to the Argent Dawn as proof of slain undead.

faq.q: Who is funding or leading the response in Darnassus?
faq.answer: The Argent Dawn coordinates the investigation through Lieutenant Beitha. The order is devoted to opposing the Scourge.

faq.q: Can listening to the runic circles harm you?
faq.answer: No one knows their exact effects. Beitha asks defenders to investigate the strange energy around the circles.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you see the necropolises and undead near Teldrassil's holy ground as a violation that must be purged.
As an Alliance member, you join Darnassus's defense against the Lich King's invasion force.
As a priest, you face corrupted necromantic runes and the whispers passing through the Scourge's dark network.
As a druid, you see necromancy and decaying flesh on Teldrassil as a blight you are sworn to eradicate.
